subject.callable: direct Triton float32 ascending row sort with original indices
subject.boundary: one launch with 32 Triton programs sorting every row of one contiguous 32x32 input and returning the complete values and int64 original indices

tasks.task_statement: Sort every row of the received physical finite contiguous float32 matrix in ascending order and return every ordered value and its unique original column index; every received row has pairwise distinct values.

input_map.basis: the public task sorts rows along dimension one
